text.insert: The epoch boundary serializes integration, report rebuilding, upstream reconciliation, publication checks, and admission of the next epoch. Mechanical build failures can invoke a bounded Codex build-fixer. Regression and QA findings enter knowledge as deferred evidence instead of creating boundary repair epochs.

The scheduler enters the boundary after the epoch has no remaining runnable work or active claims. The default boundary retry policy allows five failed attempts, starting with a 120-second delay and exponentially increasing to a 1,800-second cap. Retry timing and exhaustion are persisted; exhaustion parks the run for operator recovery.

A retained integration attempt can reuse its committed snapshot. That path skips the report and snapshot steps, checks evidence for the same epoch and attempt, and reruns missing boundary sync, breakage, CI/pre-commit, and draft-PR steps. It records skipped_steps and rerun_steps. This recovery path is distinct from the normal path and requires its own gate audit.

steps.text: Drain accepted integration work. Run configured complete-unit checks and pre-commit autofix before the snapshot.
Commit the boundary snapshot, excluding worker-locked paths. Prepare the isolated epoch worktree and configure the build.
Build the report. When enabled, one mechanical build-fixer attempt can run after a report-build failure, followed by one report retry.
Read the report and run the confirmation pass for cross-file effects. Run the QA scan and copy report artifacts to the harness checkout.
Advance the rolling report baseline. Plan regressions with the configured threshold, default 12 regressed functions, and write deferred findings. Boundary repair requeued remains zero.
Record epoch_finish save-point evidence. Merge upstream using the configured policy, score by default, and refresh the report.
Boundary sync can run its own bounded build-fixer after a post-merge build failure. Record displaced targets as V2 events for later admission.
Run V2 subject reconciliation, citation re-anchoring, PR, Discord, and attempt intake for merged upstream evidence. Record pr_sync evidence and advance the anchor and head.
Run the master breakage gate. Confirmed function or data-section breakage can pause the run; exact moved matches are handled by the gate.
Run configured CI parity and pre-commit gates. In the normal path, failed or errored gates skip draft-PR publication.
Publish the harness draft PR when enabled and the normal publication gates permit it. Record its result.

A regression pause records typed epoch evidence and returns without next-epoch admission. Otherwise run enabled knowledge maintenance, close with durable evidence, and admit the next epoch from the board.

text.insert: The build-fixer runs codex exec with gpt-5.6-sol, low reasoning, fast mode, and workspace-write. Its timeout is five minutes. A timeout or nonzero agent exit discards fixer changes and fails the boundary. Only a successful fixer exit leads to one report-build retry; that report result determines whether the candidate repair can proceed.

The epoch-worktree repair requires a clean starting tree. Successful report retry propagates only a checked tracked diff: untracked additions are rejected, existing harness-worktree edits on affected files block propagation, and git apply --check must pass. The host commits the repair and resynchronizes the epoch worktree. Failed report retry discards fixer changes and records the boundary failure.

The post-merge boundary-sync fixer edits the canonical harness worktree under its clean-tree guard, retries the report after a successful agent exit, and commits only after that report succeeds. A failed attempt discards its changes. Build repair is a narrow failure lane, separate from normal matching workers and deferred regression work.

Full boundary maintenance uses the configured maintenance mode and registered runners. It surveys PR indexing, runs enabled tool runners and indexes, applies configured enrichment, and rebuilds the code graph. The source list is registry-driven; a fixed ten-source inventory is not its contract. This maintenance is separate from V2 librarian task intake.
